data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Controlled drugs are subject to strict governance due to their potential for misuse and harm. Injectable controlled drugs, in particular, require close monitoring to ensure safe administration and compliance with national standards. The Controlled Drug Injections Practice Report in ePACT2 provides authorised users with detailed insights into prescribing and administration patterns for injectable controlled drugs at practice level.

This report enables practices to review the volume and cost of controlled drug injections, identify trends, and assess whether prescribing aligns with clinical guidance. Users can filter data by drug category, time period, and organisation, supporting targeted analysis and informed decision-making. The report also helps practices validate claims for personally administered items and ensure accurate reimbursement.

The aim of this report is to promote transparency and accountability in the use of injectable controlled drugs. It supports medicines optimisation by highlighting variation in prescribing and administration, enabling practices to identify areas for improvement and share best practice. While the report provides detailed operational and financial data, it should be used alongside other dashboards and clinical information to inform decisions. Its intention is to help generate discussion within local health economies, reduce unwarranted variation, and improve patient safety.
